title: Haggai Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Haggai 1: the word to Zerubbabel and Joshua, the house that lies waste, and the people who go up to build.

questions.text: In which year of Darius the king did Yahweh's word come by Haggai?
questions.explanation: The word came in the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month.

questions.text: To which two men did Yahweh's word come by Haggai the prophet?
questions.explanation: The word came to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.

questions.text: What were the people saying about Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: The people said that the time had not yet come, the time for Yahweh's house to be built.

answers.text: That the time to build it had not yet come
That it had already been finished
That it should be built elsewhere
That the priests would build it

questions.text: What kind of houses were the people living in while Yahweh's house lay waste?
questions.explanation: Haggai asks whether it is a time for them to dwell in their paneled houses while this house lies waste.

questions.text: What is said about the one who earns wages?
questions.explanation: They sow much and bring in little, and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.

answers.text: He buries them in a field
He puts them into a bag with holes in it
He gives them to the priests
He lends them to his neighbor

questions.text: What were they told to bring from the mountain?
questions.explanation: They were told to go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house, so that Yahweh would take pleasure in it and be glorified.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh blow away what they brought home?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says it was because of his house that lies waste, while each of them is busy with his own house.

answers.text: Because his house lies waste while each is busy with his own
Because they had not paid the priests of the temple
Because they had served the gods of the nations
Because they had left the city gates open at night

questions.text: What did Yahweh call for on the land, the mountains and the grain?
questions.explanation: Yahweh called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil and on all the labor of the hands.

questions.text: What message did Haggai, Yahweh's messenger, speak to the people?
questions.explanation: Haggai spoke Yahweh's message to the people, saying, "I am with you," says Yahweh.

questions.text: On which day of the sixth month did they work on the house of Yahweh of Armies?
questions.explanation: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, Joshua and all the remnant of the people, and they worked on the house on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month.
